text:
incident-bot: PAGE 7243 -> /embed-api 503 surge detected in us-west — paging Jordan (primary) and Priya (secondary). auto-alert at 09:12 UTC.
Jordan: saw the page, joining. quick status: spike started ~09:10, p95 token latency up, customers seeing 503s.
Priya: I'm online. any obvious recent deploys?
Jordan: no prod deploys in last hour per deploy-bot, looks like KV cache pressure + node OOMs. logs show repeated eviction churn and gRPC pool exhaustion.
deploy-bot: no rollouts in last 60m. last deploy 09:00 UTC (model-weight-tags).
Jordan: triage plan — 1) slow down new routing to us-west 2) enable soft-fallback to smaller-quantized model variant 3) scale dedicated embed pool by +2 nodes. Priya, can you trigger scale and fallback?
Priya: on it. running:
```bash
# scale embedding pool
kubectl -n inference scale sts/embed-dedicated --replicas=6
# enable fallback route in routing-config
redwoodctl route update embed --fallback=embed-small-quant-q4
```
Priya: scaling command issued, kube reports new replicas provisioning. fallback toggle applied.
Jordan: good. adding throttling for high token-length requests at the gateway as precaution.
Liam: logs show many long-context requests from a single key, might be abuse. can we temp-rate-limit?
Jordan: yes — applied token bucket limit to that key: 100 req/min.
Priya: nodes are coming up, one replica still in CrashLoopBackOff — looking. grabbing pod logs.
Priya: pod log snippet:
```
E 09:13:05 kvcache: eviction failed, OOM when loading segment
W 09:13:06 grpc: connection reset by peer
```
Priya: restarting that pod, then health checks passed.
incident-bot: auto-note added to incident-7243: increased 503s 09:10-09:28 UTC, auto-responders triggered.
Jordan: telemetry looks better after fallback and scale; 5xx rate down from 6% -> 0.7% over 6m. still monitoring for residual errors.
Priya: customer impact: several customers in us-west experienced degraded embeddings (best-effort) between 09:10-09:25. CS notified via ops-alerts channel and a ticket created: TKT-8791.
Jordan: immediate next steps before handoff: keep fallback enabled for 30m, let autoscaler settle to stable, run one pass of evals against embed-small to check quality regression on critical prompt set.
Priya: scheduled eval run: eval-job/7243-quality at 09:40 UTC. results will post to #eng-ml.
Jordan: action items for next shift (Liam taking over):
- Verify autoscaler target settled and no further OOMs (check node pod restarts > 0).
- Confirm eval-job results and escalate if regression > 3% on top-k similarity.
- Walk through runbook section: https://redwood.runbooks/ops/embed-503 (see steps 2.1-2.4 for fallback rollback and 3.5 for emergency shard drain).
Liam: got it, I'll take primary for next 4h. I'll patch the runbook with the crashloop observation.
Jordan: handoff checklist complete: primary->Liam, secondary->Priya. Coverage gap: no additional on-call this weekend between 22:00-02:00 UTC; we've flagged for voluntary pager swap if something persists.
Priya: FYI, we should consider tuning eviction watermarks on dedicated pools — file created: ENG-OPS-EPIC-eviction-tuning.
Liam: acknowledged. leaving monitoring alert set: alert if embed_5xx_rate > 1% for 5m or pod_restart_count > 3 in 15m.
Jordan: thanks team — closing incident bridge. I'll update postmortem stub and link ticket. summary to include timeline, mitigation commands, and customer impact note.
Priya: posting incident summary to #incidents after this thread.
Liam: taking over now. ping me if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
